description: The #1 ranked OWASP ASI01 risk is Agent Goal Hijack — when an agent gets manipulated into doing something it was never hired to do. This service is your external policy engine. It compares every proposed action against the agent's original goal, enforces spend limits, detects goal drift, and blocks unauthorized agent-to-agent transactions before they execute. $0.004/verification via x402 on Base. MCP tool name: verify_agent_trust
